subject: System Design
title: The Robinhood GameStop Halt
description: A quick win: understand The Robinhood GameStop Halt.

hook.text: In January 2021, Robinhood blocked users from buying GameStop stock during a historic rally.

buildup.text: GameStop's price surged 1,700% as retail investors coordinated purchases on Reddit's WallStreetBets.

discovery.text: Robinhood halted buying because it couldn't meet the collateral requirements at its clearinghouse.

twist.text: Users thought it was market manipulation. It was actually a liquidity and system design problem.

climax.text: Robinhood's system wasn't designed for the scenario where millions of users buy the same volatile stock.

punchline.text: Unprecedented demand exposed a design gap, not a conspiracy.

quiz.question: Why did Robinhood halt GameStop purchases?
options: It couldn't meet clearinghouse collateral requirements
